status: frozen before imagery/label download, fitting or evaluation
primary_split: geographic collection holdout; event identity/timestamps not asserted

training_sampler.selection: uniform without replacement among feature-valid handlabel0/1 pixels; sorted chip order, one fixed generator

imagery.grid_description: nominal10m; source geographic chip grids retained
imagery.validity: both band read_masks positive and both finite; any external geometry mask intersects validity

feature_recipe.average_domain: clippeddB statistical features, not a claimed physical mean power
feature_recipe.invalid_samples: exclude from sum and denominator; no nan_to_num into valid values
feature_recipe.center_validity: both bands valid; neighborhood counts retained as feature

evaluation.final_test: evaluate once after training artifact and code/data manifests freeze
metrics: full confused counts TP/FP/FN/TN on label-valid+feature-valid pixels
conservative full-label water recall treats unsupported water unknown as not detected

limitations: Supervised water vsnonwater baseline only; no debris classifier
Permanent water and flooding are not distinguished by handlabels
No calibratedprobability or absolute geolocation claim
Ground-grid sigma0 preprocessing/domain differences limit transfer to Himalayan terrain
